name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Ptrs.stable
typeText:
∀ {m m' : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem} {V ptrs : List.{0} Nat} {ls : List.{0} (List.{0} Nat)},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Agree m m' V →
    (∀ (x : Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} V x → LT.lt.{0} x DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN) →
      DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Ptrs m ptrs ls → DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Ptrs m' ptrs ls

source.code:
theorem Ptrs.stable {m m' : Mem} {V : List ℕ} {ptrs : List ℕ} {ls : List (List ℕ)} (hag : Agree m m' V)
    (hV : ∀ x, x ∈ V → x < IN) (h : Ptrs m ptrs ls) : Ptrs m' ptrs ls := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
  refine ⟨h1, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := h2 i hi
  refine ⟨c1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hag.heap hV _ c1 (by omega)]; exact le_trans c2 hag.2
  · rw [hag.arrAt hV _ c1 c2]; exact c3
